name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russian attacks killed five and injured 15 in the day to 18 Nov, hitting energy sites in three regions
state: Russian attacks killed five people and injured 15 across Ukraine in the day to 18 Nov, damaging energy infrastructure in Kyiv, Mykolaiv and Rivne oblasts (Kyiv Independent). This followed the 17 Nov strikes that hit Kyiv's Southern and Northern bridges, when 14 were killed and 78 injured over a day (Kyiv Independent). Ukraine's air force said 131 of 158 drones were downed overnight into 16 Nov (Interfax-Ukraine). Sustained mass strikes on infrastructure keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO advice against all travel to Ukraine. Strikes on energy sites can affect European power and gas markets.
rubric_hit: Mass strikes on infrastructure and bridges, 14 killed on 17 Nov = significant escalation, Alert
